tagline: Official fynk hosted MCP coverage: review before an agent sends contracts for signature or changes who signs.
summary: Opt-in HOL Guard coverage for the fynk MCP Server, published by fynk. After local-admin enablement, Guard asks before an agent starts signing (which emails signature invitations to outside signatories), creates a document that may start signing in the same call, moves a document back to review (cancelling signing and invalidating signatures) or straight to done, adds, changes or removes a signatory, deletes account-wide document types, metadata, tags, teams or template parts, replaces or publishes a template, or changes team membership. Reads, searches, drafting and ordinary document edits keep the host's usual handling.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the reviewed fynk MCP tools and the surrounding Guard policy; tools fynk adds later inherit host handling until this entry is updated.
Remote HTTP matching is bound to https://app.fynk.com/mcp when runtime configuration evidence is available; otherwise Guard uses the configured server name only for non-allowing review defaults.
fynk connectors added through a hosted connector directory may appear under a generated server name and then fall back to Guard's normal handling.
A publisher profile or badge is not a security certification or an endorsement by HOL.
